business_outcome: A fine-tuned implementation based on Qwen2.5, EZO x Qwen2.5 achieved accuracy that exceeded that of existing closed models in the Japanese MT Bench, the top Japanese language evaluation index in Japan. It also has the advantage of being lightweight and low latency, and is able to run at high speed on large-scale servers, typically found in many industries.
